title: E2 fix round 1: timeout from config, jev logs invisible to cost/scorecard run globs, budget >=, locked state, cached key, redaction test (from review T-0226)
spec:
Fix round on task/T-0214 (commit 7692cc7 on goal/T-0201). STEP 0: your worktree was cut from goal/T-0201 and lacks that commit; run `git reset --hard task/T-0214` and confirm `git log --oneline -1` shows 7692cc7. Then address the opus review T-0226:
1. orchestrator/jev.py ask(): timeout_s=None in the signature; None means cfg["timeout_s"] from pool.toml [jev].
2. Log collision: jev usage lines must not be counted as worker runs. Write them to .orchestrator/runs/jev/<date>.jsonl (a subdirectory) and make cli.cost() and scorecard.build()/by_task()/by_goal() only read top-level .orchestrator/runs/*.jsonl lines that carry a role key (skip lines without role, count them nowhere). Keep the E3 contract in mind: the tool-call gate will log to .orchestrator/runs/jev/gate.jsonl, so document that path in a jev.py module comment.
3. Budget check uses >= so daily_budget_tokens = 0 blocks every call.
4. _add_day_tokens: read-modify-write under an flock on .orchestrator/jev_state.json (same pattern as pool._save_planner_account) with atomic replace; a corrupt file logs one warning and keeps the previous in-memory tally rather than resetting to 0 within the process.
5. _api_key(): resolve once per process and cache for 10 minutes (module-level cache with timestamp); never log the value.
6. Redaction before truncation, and a capture-based test asserting a sk- style token placed in the state never appears in the request body.
Tests: tests/test_jev.py gains test_timeout_from_config, test_budget_zero_blocks, test_state_lock_and_atomic_write, test_api_key_cached, test_redacted_before_send; tests/test_scorecard.py and tests/test_cli.py gain a test that a jev line in runs/ is ignored. Commit on the task branch when green.
acceptance: git log on the task branch contains 7692cc7 below the fix commit
All tests from T-0214 still pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

constraints.planner_note: complexity 3 on purpose: one opus review already ran; remaining items are two med and four low; merges directly at a green gate per the 2026-09-19 review decision

result.summary:
7692cc7 sits below the fix commit, as required. Done.

## Summary
Addressed all 6 points from opus review T-0226 on `orchestrator/jev.py`:
1. `ask(..., timeout_s=None)` — falls back to `cfg["timeout_s"]` when not given explicitly.
2. Jev usage lines now go to `.orchestrator/runs/jev/<date>.jsonl` (own subdir); `cli.cost()` and `scorecard`'s `build()`/`by_task()`/`by_goal()` (via `_read_jsonl_entries`) now also skip any top-level run line missing a `role` key. Module docstring documents the E3 gate's `runs/jev/gate.jsonl` path.
3. Budget check changed to `>=` so `daily_budget_tokens=0` blocks every call.
4. `_add_day_tokens` does a locked (flock on a sidecar `jev_state.lock`) read-modify-write with atomic replace (tempfile + `os.replace`); a corrupt state file logs a warning and falls back to the in-process `_tally_cache` instead of resetting to 0.
5. `_api_key()` caches the resolved key for 10 minutes (module-level cache + `time.monotonic` timestamp); never logs the value.
6. State is now redacted before truncation, preventing a token straddling the cutoff from leaking a partial fragment.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/jev.py`, `orchestrator/cli.py`, `orchestrator/scorecard.py`, `tests/test_jev.py`, `tests/test_scorecard.py`, `tests/test_cli.py`.

**Test output:** all green — `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exits 0; `test_jev.py` (11 tests incl. the 5 new ones), `test_scorecard.py::test_jev_lines_ignored`, and `test_cli.py::test_cost_ignores_jev_lines` all pass. No failures to report.

Committed as `1fbbe5f` on `task/T-0227`, with `7692cc7` (T-0214) below it.
